summary: Maps an integer type id in the range 0-4 to a pit/garage menu string literal via a jump table: 0 -> StopGo, 1 -> Fuel, 2 -> Tyres, 3 -> Wing, 4 -> Damage, and any other value to the Error string. Returns the selected string pointer. Part of the pit strategy / HUD menu string system; called from sub_49F1C0 (0x0049F1C0).

local_names.this: integer type id (0-4) delivered in the thiscall register; not an object pointer

operations.description: Dispatch on the integer type id via the switch jump table at 0x004A4810; values outside 0-4 fall through to the default case.
Case 0: select the StopGo string literal (0x005CD4D4).
Case 1: select the Fuel string literal (0x005CCC78).
Case 2: select the Tyres string literal (0x005CD4F0).
Case 3: select the Wing string literal (0x005CD4E8).
Case 4: select the Damage string literal (0x005CD4E0).
Default: select the Error string literal (0x005CD4CC).
Return the selected string literal pointer.
